sourceReferences: design-review-locked/Mentora Showcase.dc.html § 22 Product Preview — mobile mockup only
highestMatchingScreen: This screen and purchase-success.json were the two HIGHEST-scoring screens (91%/93%) in the original 24-screen visual audit — both essentially reproduce the mobile reference's copy, structure, and control layout almost exactly, despite being approved-pattern (mobile-mockup) rather than exact-showcase.

layout.structure: single-column card at form-width cap, every breakpoint — Checkout/OrderSummary component

content: course thumbnail + title + instructor (reuses courseCard's compact content pattern)
demo price (+ original price if used for discount presentation)
"Demo Payment — no real charges or payment information required." — info.container/onInfoContainer

closedFieldSet.rule: EXHAUSTIVE, CLOSED field list — course line item, price rows, total, demo-payment notice, confirm/cancel actions. MUST NEVER contain card number, CVV, expiry, billing address, bank information, or any payment-provider logo implying real integration.

states.processing: confirm button's own Loading state, rest of summary static
states.error: inline 'Demo checkout could not be completed. Try again.' + Try Again

rtlBehavior: notice text and price rows follow logical start/end; total amount stays Western Arabic numerals regardless of locale
responsiveRules: single-column card at form-width cap, every breakpoint
